classification: owner-requested post-result development experiment; not validation

motivating_failure.causal_revision: The prior arm translated source traditions into a project-authored +/-1 testimony grammar. V1.3b instead preserves each tradition's own numerical strength machinery and treats traditions as separate models.

lilly_core_fortitude.omission_reason: Keep the first source-native numerical pass mechanically bounded to factors that can be implemented unambiguously from the cited table without adding another interpretive/oracle dependency. Omissions are frozen before owner scoring and may not be selectively restored after reveal.
lilly_core_fortitude.triplicity: Ptolemy/Lilly day/night triplicity rulers as published in the essential-dignity table.
lilly_core_fortitude.terms: Ptolemy/Lilly terms as published in the essential-dignity table.
lilly_core_fortitude.faces: Ptolemy/Lilly faces/decan rulers as published in the essential-dignity table.

parashari_shadbala.engine_role: private development oracle only; no PyJHora code is copied into the project
parashari_shadbala.shadbala_value: PyJHora normalized sb_strength output = Shadbala rupas / tradition-specific required factor for each of Sun through Saturn.
parashari_shadbala.validation_note: PyJHora documents tests against V.P. Jain and B.V. Raman examples, while also noting some disagreement with Jagannatha Hora. Treat this as practitioner/reference implementation evidence, not scientific validation.

domain_to_significator_rule.lilly: Use only Lilly-tradition planet and house mappings. A mapped house contributes its candidate-specific traditional lord from the Regiomontanus cusp sign.
domain_to_significator_rule.parashari: Use only Parashari-tradition planet and house mappings. A mapped sidereal whole-sign house contributes its candidate-specific classical sign lord.
domain_to_significator_rule.deduplication: Within one tradition/domain/candidate, the same planet counts once even if reached through multiple mapped roles.

within_tradition_aggregation.domain_mean_nonstack: For each behavioral domain, average the native strength values of its unique mapped significators; then sum domain scores.
within_tradition_aggregation.significator_stack: For each behavioral domain, sum the native strength values of its unique mapped significators; then sum domain scores.

behavioral_weight_variants.equal_domain: Every supported mapped behavioral domain weight = 1.
behavioral_weight_variants.frozen_measurement_confidence: Use the already-frozen target-blind behavioral confidence for that domain.

convergence_rule.per_spec_direct_pass: Target must strictly beat persistent 2013 and no predeclared same-date alternative may strictly beat target.
convergence_rule.tradition_pass: A tradition passes only if at least one of domain_mean_nonstack or significator_stack passes under BOTH behavioral-weight variants.
convergence_rule.convergence_pass: Both Lilly and Parashari traditions pass independently.
convergence_rule.century_rank_admission: Only convergence_pass admits any V1.3b century-scale ranking. One-tradition-only success remains a diagnostic.

no_claims: This is still owner-case development/post-selection evidence.
Historical/practitioner source-native weights are externally grounded but not empirically calibrated probabilities.
A pass would not validate astrology; a fail would reject this frozen source-native candidate on the owner development case.
